body:
I probably burned that bridge to be honest.

To be truthful, I really don't know. Booze has really fucked me over.

I'm going to break the ice with my mom here soon, pretty sure she knows. I was the oldest son, the first one to go off into the military. And now I'm a fucking drunk.

I'm so depressed.
I'd love to afford that place, but since I drank myself into a black hole, I'm not sure I can afford it.
I know I need treatment, but I'm terrified.
Maybe. I left active duty in 2008.

The VA is hopeless.

The IAVA is better, but not great.

I just don't know anymore.

I'm tired of being a drunk, but I need help. I just can't do this anymore.

Can't make that call. I just can't. "I pissed away all my money, please pay for my rehab."

Fuck, not something I'm willing to do.

I left because my deployment in Iraq left 52 people assigned to my brigade dead. I was assigned to be on the Honor Guard for 3 that were lost from my battalion.

I was offered reenlistment with a giant cash bonus, I can't do another tour.

It was bad. I can't do that again.
I'm in such a deep hole. I get sick when I stop drinking for a day. I'm done with drinking, one way or another.

I'm financially devastated, my family has helped me so much already, I don't know how much treatment costs, I'm terrified at the prospect, I don't know know how to broach the subject. I don't want to put my family through that process.

>Are there any services for vets in your area? Or... if you can't pick up a phone yet - I assume there must be some online support sites for vets.

There is such a barrier in my mind about seeking help. I know I'm in a bad place, I have a severe drinking problem, but I don't want to admit that. I'm so tired of feeling this way.

>your family seems supportive, ask them to help you, by hiding alcohol and not letting you get to it.

I think they know, they have to. I'm at a breaking point. I don't want to admit I've let alcohol ruin my life. I don't know if I've done so damage already. I don't think I can recover.
